name: Success Kid
look: A baby with light brown hair and a green and white shirt holds up a clenched fist in front of his chest with a smug, determined frown. The photo is set on a blue and purple pinwheel background.
use: Celebrates a small win or lucky break. The top caption sets up an everyday situation and the bottom caption reveals the minor victory, with the baby's clenched fist working as a triumphant fist pump.
examples: Opened the door before the beep
Got to the bus stop late
describe: baby clenching his fist with a determined face
toddler fist pump on a blue background
little kid in a green shirt making a victory fist
smug baby squeezing his fist like he just won
proud baby with a clenched hand celebrating
origin: A 2007 photo, taken by the boy's mother, of her baby son on a beach clutching a fistful of sand.
